items.note: Municipal page (published 03.02.2026): council resolution of 10.02.2022, no. 8 approved the PUMS; city executive (Stadtrat) resolution no. 324 of 25.08.2021 adopted the draft; 50 % of the specific vehicle traffic entering the city goes to the old town; core measures include Brixen 30 km/h and 'more people and fewer cars in the centre: parking, ZTL, bike parking'; pedestrian-friendly old town. All as drafted.

Read the page and the linked PDF (Einheitstext). Council resolution no. 60 of 30.11.2022; page publication date 20.10.2025. Art. 10: rules apply only to spaces with disc parking of 90 minutes or more and to reserved resident zones. Art. 11: the permit allows parking but does not guarantee available spaces.

stol.it article (published 2026-02-27 about the 'Mehr als 30 Jahre in Betrieb' section): garage built 1993 by Parking Brixen GmbH (later Seeste Bau GmbH), operated more than 30 years, passed to the municipality at the end of January 2025 after the concession contract expired.

stol.it article of 27 Feb 2026 (a Friday, 'am heutigen Freitag'): settlement before the Bolzano regional court between the municipality and Seeste Bau; Seeste Bau pays a one-off sum for maintenance pre-financed by the municipality, pays the pro-rata concession fee for January 2025 and bears the cost of structural securing for ten years; works to keep operation going as unrestricted as possible. The text matches.

Municipal notice (published 07.01.2026): executive resolutions 486, 488, 489 of 03.12.2025; new tariffs in force 01.01.2026. Parkhaus 2.30 EUR 07-21, 1.20 EUR 21-07, first 30 min 1.20 EUR; Priel 2.00 EUR (07-20), 1.20 EUR night, first 30 min 1.20 EUR; Mobility Centre 2.00 EUR (07-19), 1.20 EUR night. Matches. Service pages read in October 2026 show the same figures.

Municipal news item (published 04.12.2025): executive resolution no. 487 of 03.12.2025 following provincial government decision no. 788 of 07.10.2025; new tariffs in force from 05.12.2025: 2.00 EUR/h (08-20), 1.20 EUR/h night (20-08), monthly 24 h subscription 40 EUR. The item text states no hours, so the researcher's flagged conflict (notice 08:00-20:00 versus the Rosslauf service page 07:00-19:00, which I also read) does not affect the item. Worth keeping out of the text.

Municipal notice published 24.06.2026: from 1 July 2026 charges at metered lots adjusted to the consumer price index; most current tariffs date from 2004; Brennerstrasse (Goldenes Roessl), Elvaser Strasse, Romstrasse 2.50 EUR/h, max 1 hour; stated aims: more turnover, and to draw attention to the cheaper barrier car parks and the Parkhaus. Worded as announced; acceptable.

stol.it of 6 May 2026 describes a council decision and uses future wording: the 99 spaces in the southern part of Priel 'wird ... angepasst' to the northern barrier part (2 EUR per hour by day, 1.20 EUR for the first 30 minutes and 20-07), and 'aufgrund der hohen Auslastung' no subscriptions are offered. The article says increases apply 'ab 1. Juli' (stated explicitly for the three streets, not specifically for Priel). The draft says 'were aligned', which is stronger than a report published two months earlier; reword as decided/announced. The rest (no occupancy figures) is right.
items.corrected_text: A stol.it report of 6 May 2026 on the city council's decision on the remaining blue-zone tariffs says the tariff for the 99 spaces in the southern part of the Priel car park is to be aligned with the barrier-controlled northern part (2.00 EUR per hour by day, 1.20 EUR for the first 30 minutes and from 20:00 to 07:00), and that no subscriptions are offered there because of the lot's high utilisation. This is a qualitative remark; no occupancy figures were given.

items.note: Municipal news item published 09.09.2026: on 16 and 17 September 2026 the Parkhaus Brixen system is integrated into the system of Priel, Rosslauf and the Mobility Centre; temporary disruptions possible; old subscription cards stop working after the switch; new cards issued at the entrance barrier on those days (also available from now at the counter 07:00-09:00 and at the local police). Page is an advance notice only, so 'announced' wording is right; completion is not confirmed by any source read. The summary must keep 'announced'.

Municipal service page (last changed 04.07.2026): the municipality runs all paid car parks; barrier-controlled: Priel, Rosslauf underground, Parkhaus Brixen, Mobility Centre; metered: Zinggen (Eurospar), Stufels, Elvaser Strasse, Brennerstrasse, Am Priel (south), Romstrasse, Vintlerweg, Kreuztal = eight; EasyPark and myCicero; only free lot is Fischzuchtweg, 06:00-22:00.

Municipal service page (last changed 18.02.2026): Dantestrasse 13, five levels, 550 spaces plus 44 garage boxes; height limit 2.20 m, 1.90 m on level -2; day tickets 18 EUR (1 day) and 31 EUR (4 days); four automatic pay machines. The page predates the September 2026 system switch, so payment details may have changed since. No conflicting capacity figure appears on the page.

Municipal service page (last changed 18.02.2026): Niccolo-Castiglioni-Strasse north of the station, 180 spaces; Suedtirol-Pass Park & Ride daily maximum 6.00 EUR, reduced by 3.00 EUR per validation at the Mobility Centre (6.00 for two); monthly 60 EUR (day), 80 EUR (24 h), 50 EUR for residents without garage.

Municipal service page (last changed 18.02.2026): Priel is for short-term parkers, no weekly/monthly subscriptions, no vehicles over 5 m or with trailers, Acquarena discount, UnipolMove (if activated for the lot) and EasyPark open barriers automatically, contactless up to 25 EUR. But the two pay machines are 'unmittelbar neben der Ein- und Ausfahrt' (next to the entry and exit), not 'exit machines'. No availability display is mentioned on the page.
items.corrected_text: Priel is a barrier car park open to short-term parkers; weekly and monthly subscriptions are not available, and vehicles over 5 m in total length or with trailers may not enter. Two automatic payment machines stand directly next to the entry and exit (cash or card; amounts up to 25 EUR can be paid contactless). If UnipolMove is activated for the lot, the fee is charged through it and the barriers open automatically; EasyPark can also be used, with automatic barrier opening. Acquarena swimming pool visitors get a reduced parking fee. The page does not mention a live availability display.

items.note: Suedtirol News, published 2026-08-07: the provincial government approved the change to the technical features of the Suedspange after its meeting on 7 August; 12 million EUR contribution for the municipal section; aim to relieve the town centre and Milland; about 72 m arch bridge over the Eisack; future Plose cable-car valley station better connected. Described as approved design changes, not as built.

Plose operator page (undated; read on 21 October 2026, date 2026-10 is right): valley station of the Plose gondola is 7 km from Brixen just after St. Andrae, large free visitor car park, bus line 321 connects Brixen (and stops at the railway station). Note this describes the existing gondola station at St. Andrae, not the planned new valley station mentioned in the Suedspange item; the page carries a development-site banner.

Brixen Tourismus page (undated; read on 21 October 2026): FAQ says to allow more time before events, on market days and in the Christmas period; coaches may stop 15 minutes in Regensburger Allee and then park at Parkplatz 3, Schilfweg, with a 25 EUR day ticket. No AI label found, though the FAQ is generic wording; low information value but accurate.

corrected_summary: Bressanone (Brixen) runs its paid parking itself: the municipality manages four barrier-controlled car parks (Parkhaus Brixen in Dantestrasse, Priel, the Rosslauf underground car park and the Mobility Centre) and eight metered lots. The Dantestrasse garage, built in 1993 and run for more than 30 years by a private concessionaire, passed to the municipality at the end of January 2025; in a court settlement on 27 February 2026 the former operator agreed to bear the cost of structural securing for ten years. The city executive raised tariffs at the garage, Priel and the Mobility Centre from 1 January 2026 and at the Rosslauf underground car park from 5 December 2025, and announced on 24 June 2026 that tariffs at metered lots would be adjusted to inflation from 1 July 2026, with a one-hour limit at most of them, partly to draw drivers towards the cheaper barrier car parks and the garage. On 9 September 2026 the municipality announced that the garage's ticketing system would be integrated into the system of Priel, Rosslauf and the Mobility Centre on 16 and 17 September 2026; completion was not confirmed by any source read. The mobility plan (PUMS, approved by the council on 10 February 2022) aims at fewer cars in the old town, and in August 2026 the provincial government approved changed technical features of the Suedspange bypass, with 12 million EUR for the municipal section. No live availability display, official utilisation statistics, Christmas-market traffic plan or Stadtwerke-run charging data were found; the only utilisation remark is a qualitative note of high utilisation at southern Priel.
